name: "icapital.biz Berhad"
recent: iCapital.biz Berhad 近期出现多项重大诉讼公告，同时 City of London Investment Management 持续申报股权变动。公司已发布2026年报并召开第22届常年股东大会，最新季度（截至2026年5月31日）营收与净利均同比增长。
notable: 公司于2026年10月22日及11月17日发布重大诉讼公告。
City of London Investment Management Company Limited 在2026年11月多次申报股权变动。
公司于2026年10月8日发布截至2026年5月31日止季度的季度报告。
risks: 公司有重大诉讼事项，需关注后续进展。
基金管理人员 Tan Teng Boo 的关联方在公开市场交易公司股份。
earnings: 截至2026年5月31日止季度，营收为4,282,000令吉，环比增长79.7%，同比增长44.8%；净利为1,194,000令吉，净利率27.9%，较上一季度的-11.6%转正。

recent_en: iCapital.biz Berhad has recently made several material litigation announcements while City of London Investment Management continued to file changes in shareholding. The company has released its 2026 annual report and held its 22nd AGM, with the latest quarter (ended 31 May 2026) showing year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit.
notable_en: The company made material litigation announcements on 22 October 2026 and 17 November 2026.
City of London Investment Management Company Limited filed multiple changes in shareholding in November 2026.
The company released its quarterly report for the period ended 31 May 2026 on 8 October 2026.
risks_en: The company has material litigation matters; further developments should be monitored.
Associates of fund manager Tan Teng Boo traded the company's shares in the open market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 May 2026, revenue was MYR4,282,000, up 79.7% QoQ and 44.8% YoY; net profit was MYR1,194,000 with a net margin of 27.9%, turning positive from -11.6% in the previous quarter.
